_notes.source: elitetraderfunding.com blocks automated access (HTTP 403) and has no recent Internet Archive copy, so only its official help centre was read, fetched 2026-10-11: https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/how-the-1-step-plan-works, https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/how-the-end-of-day-plan-works, https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/how-the-static-account-plan-works, https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/contract-limits (account sizes and contract limits), https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/how-do-payouts-work (reward cycle caps), https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/countries-restricted-and-supported, https://help.elitetraderfunding.com/help/supported-platforms-data-feed; Trustpilot https://www.trustpilot.com/review/elitetraderfunding.com.
_notes.pricing: PRICES NOT RECORDED. Prices, profit targets and drawdown amounts are on the main site's pricing page, which we couldn't open. All are null until we have screenshots. Evaluations are a subscription renewed every 30 days until you pass (help centre).
_notes.rules_detail: 1-Step: trailing drawdown on open (unrealised) profit, 5 minimum trading days (skippable with a paid add-on), no time limit. End of Day: drawdown trails the end-of-day balance, plus a daily loss limit from the prior day's ending balance, 5 minimum trading days. Funded drawdown stops trailing once realised profit reaches the max drawdown + $100. Static: sizes and contracts confirmed; rules page not read. Payouts need Active Trade Days (8 for the first cycle, 10 after) and are capped until a $25,000 lifetime reward cap, after which traders move to a live account.
_notes.payout_caps: First reward-cycle maximum recorded; caps rise in later cycles (e.g. 1-Step 50K: $1,000 / $1,250 / $1,500 / $1,750; Static and EOD 50K: $1,250 / $1,500 / $1,750 / $2,000).
_notes.payout_wording: The help centre has a '48-Hour Reward Guarantee' article (a promise about payout processing time). We don't repeat that wording.
_notes.not_listed: Fast Track, Diamond Hands, Direct to Funded (DTF) and the legacy plans are not listed until we can read their prices. The 250K 1-Step is no longer sold.
_notes.countries: Restricted list = countries restricted by Rise, ETF's reward provider (auto-updated list, last verified by ETF 30 Jul 2026). You also need a country supported by Stripe for payments, and OFAC-sanctioned countries can't move to the live account. Guam, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands are unsupported.
_notes.company: Not confirmed: the main site (About and footer) couldn't be opened.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 3.8 from 1,158 reviews. 6 of the 20 newest reviews described a refused or forfeited payout; the firm replied to most. Borderline, similar to firms already listed. Passed with a warning.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official ETF page we could read. Prices especially need screenshots.

firm.name: Elite Trader Funding
firm.about: Elite Trader Funding (ETF) is a futures prop firm selling subscription evaluations, including a 1-Step plan with a trailing drawdown, an End of Day plan and a Static plan. Funded traders who reach a lifetime reward cap move on to trading a live account.

countries.notes: These are the countries ETF's payout provider (Rise) can't serve. Your country must also be supported by Stripe, ETF's payment provider, and residents of OFAC-sanctioned countries can't move to a live account. Guam, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands aren't supported.
